description:
Fetch a site's /llms.txt and validate it against the llms.txt format: served as plain text, an H1 title, summary, sections of links with descriptions, links that resolve. Reports each finding by line with its severity.

Billing: free.

Inputs: domain — hostname or URL.

Returns { url, status, missing, verdict: pass|warn|fail, counts, findings: [{ line, severity, code, message }], links_checked, links_not_checked, cached_at, since_last_check?, suggested_next, next_step }. suggested_next is the one priced step after it (on a paired WordPress site with no usable file, the plugin's llms.txt reset). missing: true means no usable file (an error status or a fetch error). On a WordPress site the free AuditAE plugin serves and maintains llms.txt automatically.

domain.description: Hostname or URL of the site.

name: check_llms_txt
title: Validate a site's llms.txt
